basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm a first-year premed student who recently discovered Reddit as a valuable resource for connecting with fellow students and sharing study tips. I'm based in Boston, where I'm currently attending university. My interests include educational tech, mobile gaming, and binge-watching Asian dramas. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and during weekends. Currently single, I spend most of my time focusing on my studies and exploring new learning tools.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a premed student, I'm building my knowledge base through my coursework, which includes biology and organic chemistry. I also explore a wide range of study aids, such as Quizlet and Anki, to enhance my learning efficiency. My passion for mobile gaming and interest in Asian dramas keep me engaged with diverse online communities.
